completionCriteria: Intent, Architecture, and Intelligence planes pass deterministic audits.
Every user-facing requirement has reciprocal journey coverage and existing test evidence.
Whole-backlog status inventories every declared item and the strict completion gate passes only after this task is terminal.
Industry standards are versioned, context-dispositioned, evidence-bound, review-expiring, and explicitly non-certifying.
Capability routing is vendor-neutral and human-gated at protected authority boundaries.
Read-only QuietPilot discovery writes nothing and surfaces repository-owner readiness gaps.
The existing five-viewport visual proof, thresholds, baseline hash, and three deterministic repair cycles remain governed and passing.
nonObjectives: Do not mutate QuietPilot, QuotePilot, a production environment, thresholds, or governed baselines.
Do not create a competing repository authority, product backlog, design memory, component system, or E2E hierarchy.
Do not execute blocked, staged, security-sensitive, architecture-sensitive, or release-sensitive backlog work without authority.
Do not claim external certification or consuming-product acceptance.
objective: Implement repository-governed Intent, Architecture, and Intelligence planes with user journeys and whole-backlog completion semantics.
title: Control-plane Intent, Architecture, Intelligence, and whole-backlog governance
